messages:
rana (partnerships): ping — reconciliation report flagged a systematic shortfall vs HW partner's invoice for February. partner ledger shows 9,400 billed units; our marketplace shows 11,850. need to triage possible double-counting or late-arrival suppression.

oliver (hw-partner): thanks for the heads-up. we ship device batches compressed and signed; recently we added chunked delivery with sequence numbers. sample envelope: 

oliver (hw-partner): ```
{"batch_id":"bch-20250228-77","seq":3,"chunks":2,"payload_base64":"H4sIAAAAA...","sig":"sha256:abc..."}
```

dez (eng-recon): looking at ingestion logs: our connector treats each chunk as an independent event if batch_id is present but seq handling is null. result: chunk 1 and chunk 2 both expanded and indexed separately — effectively duplicating merged totals when downstream aggregator re-merged per-device.

tori (finance): concretely, partner invoice line for contract hw-edge-11 shows 9,400 units; our reports list 11,850. variance concentrated on accounts receiving chunked uploads (device fleet with intermittent connectivity).

rana (partnerships): ok — two questions: 1) do we accept chunked payloads (we do) and 2) how should dedupe/upsert behave when sequence numbers indicate re-delivery or corrections?

dez (eng-recon): proposal: 1) treat batch_id+seq as canonical ordering; only apply the latest seq per batch_id within a 14-day window as the authoritative value (upsert semantics); 2) when re-processing a higher seq, emit a reconciliation delta (signed CSV) and mark earlier seq as superseded in audit logs; 3) validate batch signatures before expansion and reject partial sets until the full chunks arrive (with a 24h soft-wait).

tori (finance): we need the CSV with original vs corrected unit totals and a suggested credit amount. also require partner sign-off on the reconciliation before issuing any credits.

oliver (hw-partner): we can add a final_chunk=true flag in the envelope to speed commit, and will also include per-batch canonical_total in next firmware to make reconciles simpler. we'll approve the delta CSV once we validate.

partners-bot: created ticket PART-6055 (hw chunked-batch-upsert) assigned to dez.

dez (eng-recon): implementation steps: 1) add batch_id+seq upsert in ingestion (hotfix) that compares seq numbers and rewrites expanded events instead of blindly appending; 2) add a pre-expansion signature check to avoid partial expansion; 3) run a backfill job for 2025-02-20..2025-02-28 that computes corrected totals per invoice period and write reconciliation CSV to /shared/partners/hw-edge-11/feb-corrections.csv; 4) emit reconciliation events to the billing queue so downstream ledgers reconcile.

rana (partnerships): timeline? we need partner confirmation window and finance to hold credits until CSV arrives.

dez (eng-recon): hotfix for seq upsert in 6 hours, pre-expansion signature gate in 12 hours, staging backfill in 18 hours, prod backfill and CSV in 30 hours. will update PART-6055 with progress logs and attach CSV here when ready.

tori (finance): if corrected credits > $7,500 we escalate to finance director. keep us posted.

oliver (hw-partner): thanks — we'll pause invoice escalation for 3 business days while you run the fix and we'll review the CSV on receipt. appreciate the quick action. :pray:
